How to memorize Surah Al-Fil

Surah Al-Fil (“The Elephant”) has 5 ayahs over 1 page(s) of the standard Madani mushaf (pages 601–601, juz 30). Below is a ready-made plan you can adjust in one click: new lesson every day, recent revision and old revision included.

  • 5ayahs
  • 1page(s), mushaf p. 601–601
  • 1ayahs a day to finish in 30 days
  • 1ayahs a day to finish in one week

How long does it take to memorize Surah Al-Fil?

It depends on your daily pace. With 6 study days a week:

New portionStudy daysDuration
1 ayah / day5less than a week
2 ayahs / day3less than a week
3 ayahs / day2less than a week
5 ayahs / day1less than a week

These figures cover new memorization only. The planner above also schedules sabqi (revision of the last few days) and manzil (older material), which is what makes memorization stick.

Tips that work

  • Listen first. Play today's ayahs several times with a reciter you like before reading them. Open them on Quran.com.
  • Small, then join. Repeat each ayah until you can say it without looking, then join it to the previous ones.
  • Same mushaf, same layout. Always memorize from the same page layout: your visual memory of the page will help.
  • Recite it in salah. Using newly memorized ayahs in prayer is one of the best revisions.
  • Check with a teacher. A plan organizes your effort; it does not replace a qualified teacher who corrects your tajweed.
